eligibility: Token alignment and single-token value/answer only; report every excluded item and reason. No effect-based exclusions.
primary_contrast: Compare paired changes in different-minus-same-key logprob response gap for input_swap versus baseline_swap, at .5; all arms reported.
secondary: Repeat contrast at .25; report vector and probability effects and accuracy.
interpretation: Evaluate replication per format, no head/layer reselection. Failure is evidence against generalization; low competence limits interpretation rather than silently replacing panel.
next_scope: Distinct competent tasks still required; this panel tests vocabulary transfer only.
